payload.title: File:Lapitiguana impensa.JPG
payload.description_html: Comparison of the extinct Giant Fijian Iguana, Lapitiguana impensa, and two Viti Levu Giant Pigeons, Natunaornis gigoura, from prehistoric Fiji. The latter would have been as large as chickens. The former would have been as large as a green iguana, Iguana iguana.
